dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc python3-dev && \
    pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && \
    apt-get remove -y gcc python3-dev && \
    apt-get autoremove -y && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation:
1. Requirements:
   - lief: Binary analysis library
   - splunk-sdk: For Splunk integration
   - pyobjc packages: For macOS Cocoa/Foundation/objc interop

2. Dockerfile:
   - Uses python:3.9-slim base
   - Installs build dependencies for binary packages
   - Cleanup to minimize image size
   - Note: macOS-specific imports (Cocoa/Foundation) won't work in Linux containers
